visualCharacteristics.description: Centred testimonial: optional portrait, dark-blue title, quotation in a narrow column, attribution (bold name, grey role/location), CTA button or link. Two consecutive testimonials sit side by side with a thin divider (>= 900px); white text on cobalt/blue/black bands.

contentPattern.description: Up to 5 single-cell rows: [optional portrait image] [optional title] [quotation paragraph(s)] [attribution: name line, role/location line] [optional CTA link]. Rows are recognised by content. Append #_dnb to a YouTube CTA to keep it a link.

suitableFor: customer quotes with attribution and CTA
